title: Internal: PIN Lock Investigation Protocol - Fraud Risk Scoring
summary: This document defines the Internal “PIN Lock Investigation Protocol - Fraud Risk Scoring” for debit cards with pin_locked=TRUE. It covers automatic escalations (pin_lock_reason='security_hold', other cards locked, card replaced in last 90 days for 'stolen'), a multi-flag scoring model (location/time/amount/history/account), score thresholds (0-4 LOW through 15+ CRITICAL), required customer questions, and post-unlock steps tied to prior lock frequency over 90 days.
faqs: What should I do immediately if pin_lock_reason is 'security_hold' or another card on the account is also pin_locked=TRUE?
How do I calculate the fraud risk score for a locked PIN, including location, time-of-day, velocity, and amount flags?
What customer verification questions are required for MEDIUM (score 5-7), HIGH (8-10), and VERY HIGH (11-14) risk levels?
When does the protocol say we cannot unlock the card, and what actions should we take (dispute, close card, replacement, security transfer)?
After unlocking, what additional steps are required based on how many PIN locks occurred in the last 90 days (0, 1, 2, or 3+)?
keywords: Fraud risk score thresholds (0-4 LOW, 5-7 MEDIUM, 8-10 HIGH, 11-14 VERY HIGH, 15+ CRITICAL)
Category A Location Flags (A1 Location Mismatch, A2 Location Scatter, A3 Travel Pattern Conflict)
Category B Time Flags (B2 Time Since Last Legitimate PIN Use; B3 Attempt Velocity)
Category C Amount Flags (C1 Amount Pattern; C4 Amount vs Daily Limit)
Category D Card History Flags (D1 Lock Frequency; D2 Card Age)
Category E Account Flags (E1 Account Age; E2 Overdraft History; E3 Low Balance Alert)
Enhanced verification: last 4 SSN + security question
Post-unlock notification/PIN reset offers tied to 1/2/3+ locks in 90 days
